title: Policy Effect Evaluation
description: Evaluate the causal effect of a policy or intervention: locate primary evaluation, access data/code, recompute estimates, specify identification, and surface adverse/distributional effects before a qualified claim.

common_failure_modes.note: Pre/post comparison asserted as causal effect without identification.
Headline effect accepted without independent recomputation.
Policy population/jurisdiction differs from the claim.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed QUALIFIED

stop_criteria.condition: effect recomputed, identification specified, adverse effects reviewed, obligations satisfied
stop_criteria.note: Qualified ceiling only after external review.

stop_criteria.condition: no primary evaluation or data inaccessible after search
